description: This file defines a notes repository module for managing notes stored either locally using localStorage or remotely via REST API endpoints. It includes utility functions for generating timestamps and UUIDs, classes implementing local and remote storage mechanisms, and a factory function to instantiate the appropriate repository based on environment variables.

classes.name: LocalNotesRepository
classes.description: Handles local storage of notes within the browser's localStorage.

classes.name: RemoteNotesRepository
classes.description: Handles remote storage of notes via REST API endpoints.

methods.name: nowISO()
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in ISO 8601 string format.

methods.name: safeUuid()
methods.description: Generates a UUID using crypto.randomUUID if available, otherwise falls back to a pseudo-random string.

methods.name: createNotesRepository()
methods.description: Factory function that returns an instance of LocalNotesRepository or RemoteNotesRepository based on environment variables.

methods.name: LocalNotesRepository.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a local notes repository, ensuring storage key exists.

methods.name: LocalNotesRepository._ensure
methods.description: Ensures the storage key exists in localStorage.

methods.name: LocalNotesRepository._read
methods.description: Reads and parses notes from localStorage.

methods.name: LocalNotesRepository._write
methods.description: Writes notes array to localStorage.

methods.name: LocalNotesRepository.list
methods.description: Returns all notes sorted by updatedAt descending.

methods.name: LocalNotesRepository.create
methods.description: Creates a new note with a generated ID and timestamps.

methods.name: LocalNotesRepository.update
methods.description: Updates a note by its ID.

methods.name: LocalNotesRepository.remove
methods.description: Removes a note by its ID.

methods.name: RemoteNotesRepository.constructor
methods.description: Initializes remote repository with the base URL, removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: RemoteNotesRepository._json
methods.description: Parses JSON response or throws error if response not OK.

methods.name: RemoteNotesRepository.list
methods.description: Fetches list of notes from remote server, sorted by update time.

methods.name: RemoteNotesRepository.create
methods.description: Creates a new note on the remote server via POST.

methods.name: RemoteNotesRepository.update
methods.description: Updates an existing note on the remote server via PATCH.

methods.name: RemoteNotesRepository.remove
methods.description: Deletes a note on the remote server via DELETE.
